features: ERGONOMIC & AMBIDEXTROUS DESIGN: Designed for all-day comfort with a compact, ergonomic shape that fits naturally in your hand. The symmetrical design makes it ideal for both left- and right-handed users, whether you're working, studying, or browsing.

RELIABLE 2.4GHz WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY: Enjoy a stable, lag-free wireless connection with up to 10 meters of operating range using the compact USB nano receiver. Simply plug in the receiver and start working instantly—no software installation required.

ADJUSTABLE 1000/1600 DPI OPTICAL SENSOR: Equipped with a precise optical sensor that lets you switch between 1000 DPI for everyday productivity and 1600 DPI for faster cursor movement, providing smooth tracking across different tasks.

LONG-LASTING BATTERY PERFORMANCE: Powered by a single AA battery, the energy-efficient design delivers up to 15 months of battery life under typical usage, minimizing battery replacements and ensuring uninterrupted productivity.

LIGHTWEIGHT & WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Weighing only 56g (excluding battery), the WT300 is easy to carry and perfect for home, office, or travel. Compatible with Windows 8/10 and above, as well as ChromeOS devices, making it an excellent everyday wireless mouse.
